package.description: A lightning-fast, no-build Java dependency manager

en-US.description: A lightning-fast, no-build Java dependency manager
en-US.longDescription: jar-cart is a lightning-fast, no-build Java dependency manager. It fetches, caches, and runs JAR artifacts instantly without requiring Maven or Gradle. Designed for simplicity and speed, it enables developers to manage Java dependencies with minimal setup.
en-US.name: jar-cart
